mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is a crisp 46 degrees under clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park, though we are under an air quality alert with an index of 77. Under the waxing gibbous moon, keep an eye out for the space station rising over Mount Horeb at 5:45 AM, which will travel toward Madison near the Home Depot and reach about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is offering a new toilet rebate program for property owners, while also encouraging residents to build rain gardens to help manage local flooding. You can also sign up for the Eye on Water program to track your usage and avoid leaks.

We have a busy week ahead. Today, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, check out Art House 360 or Hop Haus trivia, followed by more live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee later this week.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of erratic driving while students were on board.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so head over to enjoy a scoop before they close at 10:00 PM.
